interview.name: Quinn
interview.answer: The repair drive details haven’t been provided yet, so the time and location are still unknown.

reflections: Quinn is taking a coordinating role and follows through by sharing timing, logistics, and updates.
Pia values clear organization and practical details so the repair drive stays orderly.
Nell is appreciative but still needs proactive information to stay up to date.
Quinn is a reliable coordinator who keeps neighbors informed and helps organize participation.
Nell seems less informed and depends on Quinn for updates and context.
Tess and Noah are supportive and willing to help once they know what is needed.
Quinn is a reliable organizer who keeps people updated and recruits extra help when needed.
Noah is cooperative and appreciative, following through on requests and trying not to miss details.
Cleo and Tess are active contributors who check supplies and monitor the remaining list so the group can coordinate efficiently.
Quinn is the main coordinator and follow-through person, keeping neighbors informed and recruiting help.
The group responds positively to practical, low-pressure support and clear details about time, location, and what to bring.
Participants are working around busy schedules, so reminders and concise updates are especially useful.
Quinn is the main organizer, repeatedly promising to spread the word, send repair-drive details, and recruit more neighbors.
Dane seems supportive but slightly behind on follow-through, while still trying to help keep the effort low-key.
Oren and Rey are responsive participants who want reminders or details so they can contribute when information arrives.

events.text: Quinn: I’m going to spread the word about the repair drive and see who can help out. If you want, I can also invite a few more neighbors.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Pia: That sounds helpful—just let me know the timing and where people should bring things. I’d rather keep it organized so we don’t end up with a pile of mismatched repairs.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send out the time and drop-off spot once I’ve got them, and I’ll ask folks to label what needs fixing so we keep it tidy.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—want me to send you the details?
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Nell: Yes, please—I'd really appreciate that. I’m still catching up on the details.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the details right away, and I’ll keep an eye out for any updates too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Tess: Oh, I’m pretty sure it’s the real deal — I saw the boxes and labels myself, so it’s more than just looking busy. If you want, I can swing by and see what’s still left to do.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess — thanks! I’ll spread the word and send the timing and drop-off details as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear what’s left on the list.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate you keeping me posted. I’ll do my best to bring what I can and not miss the details.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I have the time and drop-off spot. If you want, I can also invite a few more neighbors to help out.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Noah: That’d be great, Quinn — thanks. I’ll do my best to keep up and bring whatever I can.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now and I’ll let you know what we’re short on. Once I’ve got the list, I can point you to the first repair job.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: Perfect — send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll start lining up a few neighbors to help with the first repair job.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Cleo: Will do — I’m checking the supplies now, and I’ll send you the short list as soon as I have it.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the details and keep everyone posted as soon as I have the time and drop-off spot. If you want, I can also invite a few more neighbors to help out.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Ira: That’d be great—please do, and I’ll keep an eye out for the details while I’m out.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send the details as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: I’m on it—I’ll spread the word and send you the repair drive details as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. I’m a bit behind, but I’ll catch up and help keep it low-key.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Quinn: No worries, Dane — I’ll keep it low-key and send you the details soon. If you can help, I’d love to have you join in.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and line up a few more neighbors, and if you want I can send you the repair drive details too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Quinn — that’d help a lot. I’m mostly collecting tools, spare parts, and small appliances that still work a little, so feel free to send me a reminder if I forget anything.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you a reminder with the repair drive details and the list of what to bring. I’m also going to keep recruiting a few more neighbors to help out.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still waiting on the repair details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word and line up a few more neighbors. Send the details my way when they’re ready, and I’ll help get everyone posted.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send the details as soon as they come in, and I appreciate you helping spread the word.
events.speaker: Rey
